new_weapon_workloads.method: Three separate release timing/RSS processes and three separate allocation-instrumented processes per workload/mode.100 shared-core updates, except full_encounter runs all512 recorded updates and reports raw ns plus ns_per_100 normalization; allocation samples always count the entire actual interval. Setup, source input parsing, warmup and final explicit Snapshot/digest are excluded from timer/counters and included in whole-process RSS. Warmup inputs: idle16, fist_kill400, switch_death128, shotgun_death/chaingun_death128, shotgun_player_death192, two_way256; others0. Idle uses source-compatible default commands throughout fresh setup/warmup; other inputs are recorded source streams. Duplicate labels intentionally expose the same continuous source scenario; these are not isolated action costs. Inputs are the committed C command streams including default commands after death. Shared validated glibc allocation interposer; requested bytes cumulative, not peak live heap, mappings or leak measurement. No CPU isolation or timing gate.
